answer: A walnut-shell work receipt: each identity earns a sealed receipt only by completing a unique, time-staggered job that starts at dawn and cannot be cloned, because the job's inputs are bound to that identity's own history. A sable-dark farm can copy text, but it cannot copy the receipt's chain of prior verified jobs without doing each one. Each extra fake must pay the full job time and compute again, with no shared shortcut, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand dawns of real work.
